result.brief: 提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，将未来驱动影响分解为类型化潜效应状态，经图路由到目标节点，构成 JEPA 联合嵌入预测架构的结构化潜世界模型。
result.reason: Structured latent world model with JEPA joint-embedding predictive architecture, latent-effect states rolled forward under future drivers and graph routing to targets; a representation/model contribution.
